title: Mutation points
body: Mutation points belong to the species, not to one cell. A new line starts with a hundred of them. Spending them on the tech tree unlocks a gene or a regulatory part for every cell that shares the genome.

Each time any cell of the species finishes dividing, the species earns one more point. The points are not split with the stores. A daughter is born with her half of the ATP and none of a private research budget, because there is only one budget.
